scripts.build: npm run clean-dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node prepare-package-json.js && node append-js-extension.js dist
scripts.emu: firebase use emu && npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.deploy:staging: firebase use staging && npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions --token $FIREBASE_TOKEN
scripts.deploy:staging:local: firebase use staging && npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:prod: firebase use prod && npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
